_comment: Trial 2026-10-19: StrykerJS replaces the hand-rolled 2-operator development/scripts/mutation-sweep.mjs. Sandbox lives at the repo root (outside apps/admin so the admin Vite watcher ignores it; NOT under node_modules, because vitest excludes **/node_modules/** test files). Incremental (owner 10-19): results are stored per mutant; a later run re-tests only mutants whose code or covering tests changed, so editing one function re-tests just that function's mutants. vitest.related=false: with related=true the 10-19 sample ran only 5 test files and MISSED src/lib/__tests__/execution-settings.test.ts, so 90 mutants showed as NoCoverage falsely.
